definition.world_a_rule: first_occurrence: z^*_A(x, k) = min { i in {0..L-1} | x_i == y_k }
definition.world_b_rule: last_occurrence: z^*_B(x, k) = max { i in {0..L-1} | x_i == y_k }

clean_training_history_analysis.clean_instances_definition: All x in V^L where for all i != j, x_i != x_j
clean_training_history_analysis.clean_target_identity: For any token v appearing in clean sequence x, |{ i | x_i == v }| <= 1. Hence min { i | x_i == v } == max { i | x_i == v } == i^*.
clean_training_history_analysis.clean_observable_identity: O(x_clean, y_clean, t, World A) == O(x_clean, y_clean, t, World B) identically.
clean_training_history_analysis.duplicate_masked_gradient_identity: Under Contract v1's duplicate-aware gradient masking, all collision-bearing examples receive grad_theta = 0. Clean examples receive identical gradients. Hence H_train(World A) == H_train(World B) bitwise across all training steps.

test_collision_evaluation.learner_distinguishability: IMPOSSIBLE (H_train identical, endogenous parameters identical, cannot break symmetry).

unseen_relation_counterexample.zero_exposure_training_identity: t_unseen receives 0 updates during training. Optimizer exposure is 0. H_train contains 0 bits of information distinguishing World A from World B for t_unseen.

support_derived_context_falsification.symmetric_support_failure: If support sequence is symmetric (e.g. palindrome x = [A, B, C, B, A]), z^*_A(0)=0 and z^*_B(0)=4 yield x_0 = x_4 = A. Target tokens are identical. Support context cannot distinguish identity from reversal.
support_derived_context_falsification.insufficient_support_failure: Without an oracle-supervised few-shot identifiability protocol, finite support sets under ambiguous token targets fail to uniquely identify routing coordinates.

clean_support_coverage.finding: When vocabulary size |V| < L, the Pigeonhole Principle guarantees that zero clean sequences exist. Even when |V| >= L, natural task distributions do not guarantee uniform clean support for all valid (t, L, k) cells.

content_independent_semantics.dimension: Content-independent semantics as a data contract
content_independent_semantics.finding: Assuming routing is a pure positional map g_theta(j, k, L, t) collapses APC's general semantic routing. Operations like SELECT, BIND, COUNT, and NEIGHBOR_* inherently require content-dependent addressing. Restricting the problem to positional permutations invalidates the Phase C charter objective.

opaque_task_id_transfer.dimension: Transferability of opaque task IDs vs support-derived context
opaque_task_id_transfer.finding: Opaque task identifiers (e.g. discrete embeddings) have zero transferability to held-out relations without parameter updates. Support-derived context encounters duplicate-token ambiguity in the support set itself.

optimizer_zero_exposure_consistency.dimension: Alignment with zero-exposure requirements for held-out relations
optimizer_zero_exposure_consistency.finding: Contract v1 relies on gradient descent updates on clean cells to converge routing parameters theta_route. Held-out relations are strictly prohibited from receiving optimizer updates, creating a direct operational contradiction.

collision_predicate_validity.dimension: Collision predicate without reference to oracle coordinate z
collision_predicate_validity.finding: Contract v1's predicate 'exists j != z: x_j == y_k == x_z' explicitly conditions on the ground-truth oracle coordinate z. Defining collision purely via observable targets (|{ i | x_i == y_k }| > 1) is uncomputable at inference time when y_k is unobserved, and breaks under indirect value addressing.

required_restrictive_axioms_for_contract: Axiom 1: Task semantics must be restricted exclusively to content-independent positional permutations.
Axiom 2: Vocabulary size |V| must strictly exceed sequence length L for all valid splits (|V| > L_max).
Axiom 3: Training distribution must strictly guarantee non-zero clean-sample frequency for every valid (t, L, k) cell.
Axiom 4: Held-out relations must be accompanied by an oracle-guaranteed clean support set, abandoning zero-shot transfer.
Axiom 5: Duplicate-token collision resolution at test time must be handled by external structural priors rather than learned data signals.
contract_v1_evaluation.verdict_on_v1_1: These restrictive axioms strip the APC research program of its core open-world semantic identity. Contract v1.1 is mathematically degenerative and scientifically unjustified.

recommended_actions: Formally record ADR-0151 superseding ADR-0150's stopping rationale.
Update Phase C Research Charter status from RELATION_INVENTORY_FEASIBILITY_STOP to ROUTING_IDENTIFIABILITY_STOP.
Cease all prospective Phase C architecture derivation and experimental design.
